retrievalProfile.description: A three-tiered horizontal layout featuring a central architectural subject against a seascape, framed by distressed white borders and bold geometric typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition divided into horizontal bands: a top section with large-scale display type, a middle band for secondary text, and a large bottom section featuring a coastal landscape with a prominent architectural structure. The entire image is enclosed in a rough, distressed white border.
coreVisualRelationships: Horizontal banding creates a clear hierarchy between text and image.
The blue tones of the sky and sea harmonize with the navy typography.
The verticality of the architectural subject contrasts with the horizontal layout bands.
Distressed edges provide a tactile, weathered frame to the clean digital elements.
coreInvariants: Rough, distressed white border masking the outer edges.
Horizontal color-blocked bands for text placement.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Architectural landmark positioned in the lower-left quadrant, scaled to occupy roughly one-third of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold display text in the top third of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow from the primary header to the secondary text, landing on the architectural subject and following the horizon line.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open sky and sea area in the lower two-thirds to balance the heavy typography above.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sky blue and ocean teal (background and atmosphere)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, medium-saturation blues paired with high-contrast dark navy and pure white.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'I' is rendered as a simple vertical bar with top and bottom crossbars, resembling a Roman numeral or a structural beam.

composition.relationshipToImage: placed on a light blue band

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between ultra-bold geometric display type and wide-tracked lowercase humanist sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy geometric weight and square feel of the primary header.
Provides the necessary geometric purity for the display role.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a coastal landscape with a modern white architectural landmark on the left, a blue sea, and a cloudy sky. Apply a distressed, rough white border mask around the entire square frame. Add a light blue horizontal band at the top and a white horizontal band in the middle.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place large navy blue geometric sans-serif text in the top light blue band. Place medium-sized medium-blue lowercase sans-serif text with wide tracking in the middle white band.

verificationChecks: Is the border distressed and white?
Are there distinct horizontal bands for text?
Is the primary text ultra-bold and navy blue?
Is the architectural subject positioned in the lower half?

adjustableVariables: Width of the horizontal text bands
Position of the architectural subject (left vs right)
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the distressed border does not obscure the text.
Verify the navy blue text is clearly legible against the light blue band.
Check that the horizon line is level.
Confirm the 'I' in the display text has the specific crossbar modification.
recipe.reuseFormula: Horizontal Banding + Distressed Border + Geometric Sans-Serif + Coastal Photography
